title: Maximum Spacing for K Clusters
description: Partition the vertices of a connected undirected weighted graph into exactly `k` non-empty clusters. The spacing is the minimum edge weight joining two different clusters. Return the maximum spacing achievable. Return -1 when `k` is 1 or `n` is 1 because the spacing is undefined.
hints: Sort candidate edges by weight and use a disjoint-set structure to track connected components.
Respect the stated tie-breaking rule and handle disconnected graphs if allowed.
